description: Add people to a broadcast draft, or just read who is already on it (call with neither contactIds nor populate to read). Recipients can only ever be ADDED — there is no way to remove one, so trimming an over-filled draft means deleting it and starting over. Adding still sends nothing.

contactIds.description: Hand-picked contactId values from list_broadcast_contacts (max 500 per call)

populate.description: Add everyone matching the broadcast's own segment filters (tags / subscribed). Confirm with the user first — this can be a large list

name: add_broadcast_recipients
title: Add Broadcast Recipients
